ruleName: Ball at rest moved by an outside influence
group: Ball at rest moved by an outside influence
title: What to do if your ball is moved by a dog
question: While playing from the fairway, a dog runs by and nudges your golf ball, moving it from its original spot. What is the correct action?

choices.text: Play the ball from where the dog moved it to
Place the ball back to its original spot with no penalty
Replace the ball and take a two-stroke penalty
Leave the ball and add a one-stroke penalty

explanation: If an outside influence, such as a dog, moves your ball at rest, you must place the ball back in its original position without penalty.
